notes.content:

Thank you for always playing ZOO GAMES products!
We are pleased to inform you that we have released a great bundle pack.

This bundle pack includes 2D Pixel Art Games.
Enjoy retro games that will give you a nostalgic feeling!

[h2]2D Pixel Art Game Bundle[/h2]
Titles included in the bundle:
[list]
[*]Akatsuki: Lord of the Dawn
[*]Mystic Gate
[*]Rogue Explorer
[/list]
You can get a 20% bundle discount on this bundle pack.
For details, please check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40899/]here[/url].

We look forward to working with you in the future.
